# Claude Recents Cleaner

> A small Python CLI that removes ghost folders - paths to deleted, renamed, or moved projects - from the Claude desktop app's Recent project picker. Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Stdlib-only Python 3.8+. Backs every removed session up to a timestamped tarball before deleting, so cleanup is reversible.

## Core documentation

- [README](https://github.com/bisovka-labs/claude-recents-cleaner#readme): install, usage, options, FAQ, and the storage-format reference for `claude-code-sessions/`.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/bisovka-labs/claude-recents-cleaner/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history in Keep a Changelog format, SemVer.
- [Source script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bisovka-labs/claude-recents-cleaner/main/clean-claude-recents.py): the single Python file that does the work, ~6.7KB, zero dependencies.
- [Tests](https://github.com/bisovka-labs/claude-recents-cleaner/tree/main/tests): smoke test covering dry-run, stale-folder removal, age-based removal, and backup creation.

## How the Recent list works

The Claude desktop Recent dropdown is built from per-session JSON metadata files under the OS application-support directory: `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude-code-sessions/` on macOS, `~/.config/Claude/claude-code-sessions/` on Linux, `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude-code-sessions\` on Windows. Each file (`local_<uuid>.json`) records the project's `cwd`, title, model, and timestamps. The dropdown enumerates these files, dedupes by `cwd`, and displays the basename. Ghost entries appear when the underlying folder is deleted, renamed, or unmounted; the metadata file is never garbage-collected by the desktop app.

## What the tool removes

- Sessions whose `cwd` no longer exists on disk (default behavior).
- With `--days N`: additionally removes sessions whose last activity is older than N days, even if the folder still exists.
- Never touches `~/.claude.json` (per-project settings) or `~/.claude/projects/` (the actual JSONL transcripts).

## Install

- Homebrew (macOS, Linux): `brew install bisovka-labs/tap/claude-recents-cleaner`
- Manual (any OS): `curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bisovka-labs/claude-recents-cleaner/main/clean-claude-recents.py && python3 clean-claude-recents.py --dry-run`
